text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their fierce battle electrified the hearts 
of everyone present.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The racers themselves felt the exact same 
way. It was a race where their hearts 
pounded fiercely, each giving their 
absolute all, refusing to lose to the 
other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Maruzensky timidly asks Sakura Chiyono 
O, "Do you... still want to run with me?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O answers with all her 
might: "Of course! Next time, I will 
definitely win!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fighting spirit in their eyes would 
never fade, far into the future. ...For 
that is what it means to be rivals.
